description: This file defines the SVG renderer class for Leaflet, a mapping library, including methods for creating, updating, and styling SVG vector layers, with fallbacks to VML for older browsers.

classes.name: SVG
classes.description: A class extending Renderer to handle SVG vector graphics in Leaflet maps, with methods for managing SVG elements and styles.

methods.name: getEvents
methods.description: Returns event handlers, including zoom start event.

methods.name: _initContainer
methods.description: Initializes the SVG container and root group elements.

methods.name: _destroyContainer
methods.description: Removes SVG container and cleans up references.

methods.name: _onZoomStart
methods.description: Handles zoom start event by updating the renderer.

methods.name: _update
methods.description: Updates SVG size and viewBox based on map bounds.

methods.name: _initPath
methods.description: Initializes a SVG path element for a layer.

methods.name: _addPath
methods.description: Adds a layer path to the SVG root group.

methods.name: _removePath
methods.description: Removes a layer path from the SVG root group.

methods.name: _updatePath
methods.description: Projects and updates a layer's path.

methods.name: _updateStyle
methods.description: Applies style options to a layer's SVG path.

methods.name: _updatePoly
methods.description: Updates a polygon or polyline path.

methods.name: _setPath
methods.description: Sets the 'd' attribute of a path element.

methods.name: _bringToFront
methods.description: Brings a layer to the front in DOM order.

methods.name: _bringToBack
methods.description: Sends a layer to the back in DOM order.
